outer_validation: leave one complete rainfall event out
complexity_selection: pre-specified fixed max_iter=140; no held-event or row-random early stopping
prior_control: held event excluded; each fitted event receives a prior excluding its own target

network_controls.shift: 20, 40, 80 and 160 m in four cardinal directions at inference
network_controls.group_permutation: 5 joint active-cell permutations of all primitive network fields
network_controls.zero_static_network_fields: all primitive and derived network fields set to zero at inference; the leakage-controlled fixed-network prior remains present

runtime_scope: feature construction + input assembly + estimator prediction + physical non-negativity post-processing
mike_role: descriptive external reference; never used for fitting or model selection
